target.title: fix(qqbot): strip echoed inbound metadata from replies
target.body:
﻿Closes #97980

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where QQ Bot users could see OpenClaw's internal inbound metadata at the start of replies, such as `Conversation info (untrusted metadata)` and `Sender (untrusted metadata)` JSON blocks, before the actual assistant response.

## Why This Change Was Made

QQ Bot now runs outbound-visible text through a plugin-owned sanitizer that keeps the existing assistant-visible text cleanup and strips leading echoed inbound metadata blocks before delivery. The same sanitizer is used by the QQ outbound adapter surface, by the direct QQ gateway dispatch path, and by the official C2C streaming path.

The direct QQ gateway path sanitizes block reply text before silent-reply classification as well as before delivery. That keeps metadata-prefixed `NO_REPLY` and `[SKIP]` control replies suppressed instead of stripping the metadata after the silence check and accidentally sending the control token.

The official C2C streaming path still keeps raw text for reply-boundary detection, but sanitizes the normalized visible text before starting or updating a QQ stream. Metadata-only partial updates are held until real visible answer text arrives, so the metadata block is not streamed first.

The change stays local to the QQ Bot plugin and does not alter the prompt envelope sent to the model.

## User Impact

QQ Bot replies no longer expose technical OpenClaw context blocks to end users when a model echoes the inbound prompt metadata. Users see only the intended assistant response text across adapter sends, direct static dispatch, and official C2C streaming, and metadata-prefixed silent replies remain silent.

## Evidence

Duplicate PR gate before implementation:

```text
gh search prs --repo openclaw/openclaw --state open --match title,body --limit 20 --json number,title,url,body,updatedAt -- "97980"
gh search prs --repo openclaw/openclaw --state open --match title,body --limit 20 --json number,title,url,body,updatedAt -- "内部元数据 渲染 用户聊天框"
gh search prs --repo openclaw/openclaw --state open --match title,body --limit 20 --json number,title,url,body,updatedAt -- "qqbot Conversation info Sender untrusted metadata"
```

Observed result: no open PRs matched #97980 or the QQ Bot metadata leak keywords.

Focused tests:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qqbot/src/channel.message-adapter.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/outbound-dispatch.test.ts
# passed: 2 files, 33 tests
```

The focused tests cover:

- QQ Bot outbound adapter sanitizer strips raw/fenced inbound metadata blocks.
- Direct gateway dispatch strips metadata from a normal block reply before QQ delivery.
- Direct gateway dispatch keeps metadata-prefixed `NO_REPLY` suppressed.
- Official C2C streaming does not send metadata-only partial chunks and streams only `final answer` once visible answer text arrives.

Formatting, diff hygiene, and local review:

```text
corepack pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/visible-text.ts extensions/qqbot/src/channel.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/outbound-dispatch.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/outbound-dispatch.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/messaging/streaming-c2c.ts extensions/qqbot/src/channel.message-adapter.test.ts
# passed

git diff --check
# passed

.agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode local
# passed with no reported output
```

Real sanitizer proof using the production QQ Bot visible-text helper with the issue's metadata shape:

```text
node --import tsx --input-type=module
# input: leading Conversation info + Sender JSON metadata blocks followed by "final answer"
# output: { "sanitized": "final answer" }
```

Follow-up after ClawSweeper review:

```text
# ClawSweeper reported that metadata-prefixed NO_REPLY/[SKIP] could be stripped after the silent check.
# Fixed by sanitizing block reply text before silent classification and delivery planning.
# Added regression coverage for metadata-prefixed NO_REPLY remaining suppressed.
# Also sanitized the official C2C streaming visible text path and added coverage that metadata-only partial replies are not streamed.
```


Live QQ Bot proof (2026-06-30, redacted):

```text
# isolated config/state used for proof only; QQBot AppID and user openid redacted
node scripts/run-node.mjs gateway run --allow-unconfigured --port 19037 --force --verbose

[qqbot] WebSocket connected
[qqbot] Gateway ready
[qqbot] Dispatch event: t=C2C_MESSAGE_CREATE, d={"author":{"user_openid":"[REDACTED_OPENID]"},"content":"/bot-ping", ...}
[qqbot] Slash command matched: /bot-ping
[qqbot:api] >>> POST https://api.sgroup.qq.com/v2/users/[REDACTED_OPENID]/messages
[qqbot:api] <<< Status: 200 OK
```

Copied live QQ Desktop output from the same bot chat:

```text
user: /bot-ping
bot: ✅ pong!
     ⏱ 延迟：1820ms
     ├ 网络传输：1819ms
     └ 插件处理：1ms

# sent through real `openclaw message send --channel qqbot` to the same C2C target
# original outbound input intentionally started with:
#   Conversation info (untrusted metadata): {...}
#   Sender (untrusted metadata): {...}
bot: final answer from live QQBot proof
```

Observed result: the live QQ client showed only `final answer from live QQBot proof` for the metadata-shaped proof send. The `Conversation info (untrusted metadata)` and `Sender (untrusted metadata)` prefixes did not appear in the user-visible QQ Bot message. The CLI send returned a real QQBot platform message id for that delivery.
Live QQ Bot account conversation: tested with redacted QQBot credentials in an isolated local config/state directory. The live proof used a real QQ Bot WebSocket session, a real C2C inbound `/bot-ping`, and a real `openclaw message send --channel qqbot` delivery to the same C2C target.

Follow-up after ClawSweeper waiting-on-author review (commit f2f71b291c):

```text
# ClawSweeper asked for QQ Bot sanitizer coverage beyond Conversation info and Sender.
# Extended the plugin-owned sanitizer to strip the full known leading inbound metadata sentinel set:
# Thread starter, Reply target, Forwarded message context, and Chat history.
# Added focused adapter/direct dispatch/C2C streaming regression coverage for the expanded metadata chain.

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qqbot/src/channel.message-adapter.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/outbound-dispatch.test.ts
# passed: 2 files, 33 tests

pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/qqbot/src/channel.message-adapter.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/outbound-dispatch.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/visible-text.ts
# passed

git diff --check
# passed
```

Current-head merge refresh (2026-07-03):

`	ext
# Current PR head after merging upstream/main and dropping the stale post-merge import
507dc020ef9be5ebffdf11663a828f69f36faf5b

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qqbot/src/channel.message-adapter.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/outbound-dispatch.test.ts
# passed: 2 files, 33 tests

git diff --check -- extensions/qqbot/src/channel.ts extensions/qqbot/src/channel.message-adapter.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/outbound-dispatch.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/visible-text.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/outbound-dispatch.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/messaging/streaming-c2c.ts
# passed

node --check extensions/qqbot/src/channel.ts
# passed

git commit hook oxlint on extensions/qqbot/src/channel.ts
# passed while committing 507dc020ef
`

Observed result: the branch is merged with current upstream/main; the only merge conflict was extensions/qqbot/src/channel.ts, resolved by preserving upstream's lazy runtime import while keeping the QQ Bot visible-text sanitizer wiring. A stale sanitizeAssistantVisibleText import left by the merge was removed in 507dc020ef. The focused QQ Bot adapter/direct-dispatch regression tests still pass on the current head.
Follow-up after ClawSweeper reply-chain/location review and current-main merge refresh (2026-07-03):

`	ext
# Current PR head after adding the missing builder-emitted metadata sentinels and merging latest upstream/main
4bfec400b0465d00b0233fea1da35d5886c2f9ff

# Fixed QQ Bot sanitizer sentinel coverage for:
# - Reply chain of current user message (untrusted, nearest first):
# - Location (untrusted metadata):
# The focused adapter, direct dispatch, and official C2C streaming tests now include those two blocks in the echoed metadata chain.

OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qqbot/src/channel.message-adapter.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/outbound-dispatch.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose
# passed: 2 files, 54 tests

node_modules/.bin/oxfmt.CMD --check --threads=1 extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/visible-text.ts extensions/qqbot/src/channel.message-adapter.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/outbound-dispatch.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/messaging/streaming-c2c.ts
# passed

git diff --check -- extensions/qqbot/src/channel.ts extensions/qqbot/src/channel.message-adapter.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/outbound-dispatch.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/visible-text.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/outbound-dispatch.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/messaging/streaming-c2c.ts
# passed

python .agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local
# attempted twice; first run hit Windows GBK decoding, second reached Codex reviewer but failed before review with account_share_mode_unbound. No accepted/actionable findings were produced.
`

Observed result: #98037 is merged with current upstream/main, resolves the latest GitHub conflict, and strips every known leading inbound metadata block currently emitted by src/auto-reply/reply/inbound-meta.ts for the QQ Bot adapter/direct dispatch/C2C streaming visible delivery paths.
